I finished my part of round 146. The "▶ Playing" marker in the library now sits on its own line inside the option instead of being cut off as "▶ Play". My tests all pass. The round is not verified until C's browser rows pass. Nothing is committed, pushed or stashed, HEAD is still `9a67abd`, and every round-145 change is preserved.

**What changed (only the 5 granted files):**
- **`ArrangementLibrary.tsx`:** the marker moved out of the meta row and is now the last item in the option button, with classes `whitespace-nowrap text-xs text-brand` and the new testid `arrangement-library-option-previewing`. The meta row is byte-identical, and the diff against the start copy is just the moved span.
- **LRS3 (`library-row-strings-ui.test.tsx`):** a new test that checks:
  - there is exactly one marker, it says `▶ Playing`, and it has its exact classes;
  - it is a direct child of the option button and its last element, and it is not inside the meta row;
  - the meta row has 2 children, keeps its exact className and has no `flex-wrap`;
  - the marker disappears when the preview stops.
- **DL-VAL (`studio-lab-demo.test.ts`):** a new test for the exact demo label, notice and set of collection labels, plus a check that `·` and `—` are the right characters (U+00B7, U+2014). The word "Georgian" became "English" in the 4 test titles.
- **PC2 (`collection.test.ts`):** the three purchased-collection error checks now compare against the full error messages.
- **Doc 119:** status line, a new Problem → Solution entry for this bug, the m91 sentence, the real round-145 C result plus a round-146 line, and the 4 files.

**Checks I ran:**
- typecheck, lint and read-only Biome on the 4 code/test files all exit 0.
- vitest on the 10 listed files: 128/128 pass. Only two test counts changed: library-row-strings-ui (2 → 3) and studio-lab-demo (12 → 13).
- Mutations all turned red: m97 and m98 fail LRS3 (re-run on the final version of the test), m99 fails DL-VAL, m100 fails PC2 and ST45. Each was restored and checked with sha256.
- End scope: the frozen list is OK, only the 5 grants differ from round 145, and the protected files have no diff.
- Not run (root's gate): full suite, verify, build, e2e.

**Code review:** I ran the `code-reviewer` subagent. It found no Critical or High issues. I fixed its Medium and two Lows by tightening LRS3. One Low stays as B specified: PC2's `toThrow(string)` also matches a substring, which §3.3 accepts. Its Architecture note found nothing to change; extracting `ArrangementLibraryOption` into its own file is only an idea for later.

**Quick browser probe (my own check, not acceptance):** in real Chromium at both viewports the full text shows inside the option and the marker is what you hit when you click its middle or right end. Nothing overflows sideways (option 126/126, list 134/134). The previewing option is 63.25 px tall (B predicted 63.5 ± 1), and the marker disappears on stop.

**Notes for B:**
- The exact class checks in LRS3 mean colour or font changes in VISUAL-A-OBSIDIAN will also need to update this test.
- The marker text is 54 px wide, not the 42 px in the task text; still within tolerance.
- The `▶` glyph may be read aloud by screen readers. That predates this round and is out of scope.
